| `content`    | `object`             |          | `\{\}`  | The widget config: `{ endpointSource, groupsPath?, itemsKey?, groupTitle?, groupCount?, itemTitle?, itemMeta?, columns?, extraGroup?, emptyText?, groupEmptyText?, errorText? }`. - `endpointSource` (`{ url, params?, responsePath? }`) reads the payload; tokens such as `@objectId` resolve as on every widget. - `groupsPath` (default `groups`) is the list of groups in the payload, and `itemsKey` (default `items`) the list of cards in each group. - `groupTitle` and `itemTitle` are templates (`"Phase {order}: {name}"`, `"{title}"`); `itemMeta` is a template or a list of templates joined with " · ", a part whose token is empty being left out. - `groupCount` (`{ one, other }`, `{count}` filled in) draws a count pill. - `extraGroup` (`{ title, path, itemText, join? }`) closes the grid with a dashed box whose entries, read at `path` of the payload, are one line. - `columns` (default 2) is the number of groups side by side. - `groupAction` is an action drawn at the foot of every group (as CnActionButtons draws it), with `@group.&lt;path&gt;` in its strings read from that group: `{ type: "open-form", endpoint: { url:   "/apps/x/api/phases/@group.id/steps", method: "POST" }, ... }` adds a card to the group. - `groupLines` lists templates drawn under a group's title, each left out when it does not fill (a list in place of a template is candidates, the first that fills). - `itemFlag` (`{ field, label }`) marks a card whose `field` is true with `label` ("Overdue"). - `itemsPath` with `itemGroupField` reads the cards from one flat list of the payload instead of from each group: a card belongs to the group whose `id` its `itemGroupField` names. Cards naming no group gather under `ungroupedTitle`; without that title they are left out. A language map (`{ nl, en }`) reads in the user's language, and a list of plain values reads joined with ", ". Texts go through the app's translate. |
